projects.title: PARVENETTA
desc: PARVENETTA lets you create your suit and apparel right in front of you — from jacket to pant and from T-shirt to hoodie — by selecting fabric, lapels, buttons, pockets, stitching, and more in an intuitive live configurator.

A second module, Build Your Brand, enables end-to-end customization of apparel like T‑shirts, hoodies, and zip hoodies — including pockets, trims, panel placements, and top-stitching — through a comprehensive nine‑step process.
Designed to streamline bespoke tailoring and private‑label production with a modern, visual experience for both individual shoppers and brands.

projects.title: BrickCode
desc: A lightweight, flexible job progress tracking tool designed for multi-site construction projects to monitor real-time health and daily field reports.
Implements a sophisticated domain model connecting Projects, Sites, and Jobs with trade-specific tracking for Masonry, Plumbing, Electricity, and more.
Surfaces blockers and schedule deviations through an integrated daily reporting system, allowing project managers to identify risks early and reallocate resources.
Supports detailed site specification tracking including technical HVAC requirements, electrical phases, and structural material joinery across all job types.

projects.title: The ChemistLive
desc: A full-cycle digital health platform covering weight loss, hair fall, and other treatments — connecting patients with clinicians from initial assessment all the way to medication delivery.

Built multi-step patient assessment workflows with conditional logic to evaluate eligibility, blood test ordering flows, Setmore appointment booking (virtual & onsite), and Stripe-powered medication ordering.

Developed a multi-role portal system for Managers, Admins, Clinicians, and Dieticians — each with dedicated workflows for reviewing orders, managing assessments, approving appointments, and handling patient care.
Integrated in-platform messaging, real-time treatment tracking, and approval/rejection notifications — all wrapped in a fully responsive, accessible UI built for seamless cross-device use.

projects.title: YB Consultants
desc: Students can register for universities, upload documents, and track their application status through an intuitive dashboard.
Includes an integrated search engine for institutions, allowing students to filter by country, department, and intake period for instant eligibility checks.
